summary: Iteration 40 end-to-end verification of the video-quiz + FOUNDING500 referral + certificate-integrity feature batch. Pytest suite (16 tests) all pass: referral registration (upper/lower/invalid/none), video-quiz learner GET (answers hidden), 3-strike wrong-answer reset flow with progress recalculation, correct-answer flow, admin authz (learner blocked 403), admin CRUD lifecycle (create/list/update/delete/set-video), invalid correct_index 400, sample cert PDF (200 application/pdf, %PDF magic bytes, >5KB), 404 for nonexistent cert. Manual verification: mismatched cert user_name returns 409 with 'recipient name does not match' detail. Frontend E2E via Playwright: /register with FOUNDING500 -> 200 -> lands on /dashboard; invalid code -> shows [data-testid=register-error] 'Invalid referral code'. /learn/agentic-ai-foundations/{m}/{l} renders VideoLessonPlayer with '0/2 checkpoints passed' indicator once model fix applied. Simulated timeupdate at t=9 -> [data-testid=video-quiz-overlay] appears with correct MCQ ('What distinguishes an AI agent from a simple chatbot?'). 3 wrong answers show 'Incorrect — 2 attempts left' -> '1 attempt left' -> '3 attempts used — restarting the lesson' with overlay auto-closing. Admin /admin -> tab-videoquiz -> selects Foundations course -> selects first lesson -> shows 2 seeded checkpoints -> Add checkpoint form works (rows 2->3) -> Delete restores to 2 -> save video URL persists. All feature paths working end-to-end.

action_items: STABILITY (P1): backend startup re-seeds courses with fresh UUIDs on each restart which orphans video_checkpoints (they hold the old lesson_ids). The startup routine re-applies lesson_videos by lesson_id but does NOT re-run video_checkpoints seed. Fix options: (a) make course seed idempotent (upsert by slug, preserve module/lesson ids), or (b) also invoke seed_video_quizzes at startup. Currently checkpoints must be manually reseeded after any restart.
COSMETIC: VideoQuizPanel.jsx has <span> children inside <option> elements causing React hydration warnings — replace with plain string interpolation.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (video player invisible): The Course pydantic model in models.py enforces its schema on /api/courses/{slug} responses. The nested Lesson submodel was missing `video_url: Optional[str] = None`, so even though the underlying MongoDB document had video_url set (correctly persisted via lesson_videos re-application), Pydantic's response_model filtering stripped it. Downstream, LessonViewer.jsx guards `<VideoLessonPlayer>` with `{lesson.video_url && …}` — evaluating to `undefined && …` -> never rendered. FIX APPLIED: added `video_url: Optional[str] = None` to Lesson class in /app/backend/models.py. Verified post-fix: /api/courses/agentic-ai-foundations returns video_url on the seeded first lesson and player renders. SECONDARY ISSUE (test flakiness): seed_video_quizzes.py binds to current lesson UUIDs; course seed on restart mints fresh UUIDs => checkpoints orphaned. Recommend making the course seed idempotent (upsert by slug preserving nested ids) OR calling seed_video_quizzes at startup after course-seed to re-link.
